issues.finding: Stability requires individual acceptability and no mutually improving unmatched pair under declared model; does not imply equality, total welfare maximum or everyone first choice.
Optimality concerns the proposing side across stable matchings for fixed reported strict preferences, not fastest individual outreach.
An omitted/unacceptable partner cannot be forced to fill seats. Stop when unmatched proposers exhaust acceptable options; unmatched can be valid.
DA holds are explicitly tentative; real binding contracts cannot be silently undone by algorithm.
Ties, linked quotas, couples or changing preferences require explicit extended assumptions; no blanket existence/optimality guarantee.
